title: Prove exact rational cube-query costs for cubic reader repair (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact appended cube-query cost of restoring a fixed cubic-reader batch over rational source frames. For every integer r>=2, retain all r children `y += a^3; a += b` and reproduce the eager endpoint on arbitrary incoming y,a,b.

```text
q = (2r^2 - 2r - 1)/12
rational repair queries = 2 if q is a rational square, otherwise 3
real repair queries = 2
```

Claim type: scoped mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. At r=3, two real queries suffice but three rational queries are necessary. At r=14, an explicit two-query rational program restores the actual dirty source. It saves eleven source-shift events while adding two cube queries. No backend cost saving, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

The new step is the arithmetic-sensitive cubic criterion and its restoring schedules. Credit Sricharan Vagvala / theon199's [PR1532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1532) for the quadratic fixed-reader/paid-repair interface, Adam Gall / PR1205 and Hanson Sun / PR1246 for the linear lineage, and classical binary-form power-decomposition results. No predecessor computation is rechecked as this contribution and no general Waring-rank theorem is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before allowing only rational coefficients, the real relaxation predicts two queries at every arity. After imposing the rational interface, coefficient comparison proves the exact square criterion and the three-query floor at r=3.
- CPython 3.12.15 passes 63 symbolic arities with eager/repaired/inverse endpoints, 1,798 dirty-input executions with inverse checks, 3,933 rational slope-pair coefficient cases, seven semantic controls and seven invalid-input controls.
- The exhaustive square-criterion scan covers every integer 2<=r<=10,000 and returns exactly 2,14,134,1322 as two-query arities. The all-r theorem rests on the written proof, not this scan.
- Normal and optimized direct checks take 0.26 and 0.28 seconds locally. Both registered checks pass, each below one second and its 120-second bound. Metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history checks pass for all six package files at `8b705d15869ba12d55adcb9075c68a2c7d44602d`.
- Official committed export and input-coverage checks pass. Normal and optimized direct replay pass from a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH in 0.273 and 0.271 seconds. All seven exported files retain their hashes.
- Every direct run generates a stdout JSON receipt bound to SHA256 hashes of the package files. No receipt is hand-written.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/cubic-reader-rational-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/cubic-reader-rational-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cubic-reader-rational-repair
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cubic-reader-rational-repair --check-source-history
```

Another machine may substitute its CPython 3.12 executable. Direct success is `PASS_CUBIC_READER_RATIONAL_REPAIR`; registered replay ends with `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The original calls are indivisible. Source maps are linear and independent of the output; there is no intermediate observation. Cube-query count excludes additional source transformations and coefficient preparation. PROOF.md gives the complete symbolic event tariff, with every original call and repair shift charged. Opening the child interiors permits a direct endpoint computation outside this comparison.

No supported supplier with these cubic readers is identified. Physical native realization, precision/storage, routing, compiler closure, actual backend pricing and supplier admission remain unproved. No Lean, Docker or selected scientific replay was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

Canonical base `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, priority revision 8, was refreshed before committing. The selected record resolves to PR6030 at .003125804 and is unchanged. The card changes explicitly to this nonlinear-interface side result. Live handoffs, reservations, account contributions since October 22, full main README searches and targeted merged/open PR searches found no matching result; sparse local-note and unpublished-work coverage remains incomplete.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected this account's twelve other open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, #6192 through #6199 and #6201 through #6204. None studies fixed cubic-reader restoration or computes this rational cube-query cost. No extra computations were run to check their results. PR1532 is the merged quadratic predecessor and supplies the credited interface.

## Open next questions

1. Which dyadic source and query coefficients attain the same two-query count? Start with prime-denominator tests on the normalized slopes and weights forced by the proof. Rational existence does not yet give a dyadic implementation.
2. Can an admitted indivisible cubic-reader backend make the r=14 tariff profitable? Pin one return map and price every displayed cube accumulation, source shift and physical coefficient operation. No such backend is supplied here.

The checks were confirmed once with `gh pr checks 6200 --repo CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds`. Local normal/optimized replay, metadata, publication bytes/source ancestry, export integrity and read-only Git-free replay also pass. CI certifies the registered replay at this head; independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated. Only `research/cubic-reader-rational-repair/` is added; no shared runner, selected record or frozen predecessor changes.
